title: Ultimate Henge
body:
Syntax: perform ultimate henge <target>

Description: The longest-lasting disguise as a person in the room; casting without a target removes it. Take the appearance of a person in this room. Use without a target to release your disguise; higher Henge tiers last longer. Usable with any chakra nature. Illusion lasts 45 pulses. Unlocks at level 55. Costs 45 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 5 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
